channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US announces first two deaths from cyclospora outbreak
item.description: Authorities in the Midwestern state of Michigan say that two people who died had underlying conditions.

item.title: Trump blasts ‘duplicitous’ Iran after Tehran denies it is in talks with the US
item.description: US president demands 'Total Surrender' amid escalating naval blockade in the crucial Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Uncertainty on Iranians’ minds as Trump fluctuates on war and talk
item.description: Iranians feeling pressure amid US president's on-again, off-again comments on conflict and negotiations.

item.title: Romanian navy blasts riverbed to protect nuclear plant
item.description: Romania's military detonated part of the Danube riverbed to redirect water towards the Cernavoda Nuclear Power Plant.

item.title: Pentagon boosts Patriot, THAAD interceptor output amid stockpile strain
item.description: Defence giants Lockheed and Northrop see billion-dollar deals as Pentagon accelerates missile arsenal production

item.title: At least 17 killed as Russia and Ukraine trade heavy attacks
item.description: Exchange of fire intensifies as the war, now in its fifth year, shows no signs of slowing down.

item.title: Russia says seven killed and 40 injured by Ukrainian drone hitting busy beach
item.description: Three children were killed when the drone crashed at a popular resort on the Black Sea.

item.title: Iran says it is in talks with Oman but not the US after Trump says negotiations to resume
item.description: Iran's remarks that there were no talks with the US prompts Donald Trump to issue a strong condemnation of its leadership.

item.title: Threat to oil tankers in Middle East worst since start of Iran war, analysts say
item.description: Fresh attacks on alternative shipping routes have left tankers facing an increasingly complex situation, analysts say.

item.title: Two workers killed in blast after re-entering quake-hit Japan mall on boss' order
item.description: The two women's employer has apologised for sending them back to Aeon Mall to secure cash.
